name: Cous-Cous
body:
Station and Complexity line cook 5, rotisseur 5, roundsman 5

Flavor Profiles umami, texture, salty, temperature, temperature
Additional Ingredients bitter, sour, spicy, or sweet

EFFECT

Duration 1 hour/level; Serving Size 1

DESCRIPTION

This universally useful dish is similar to rice, but far more difficult to make correctly. Making it requires hard-to-cook grain that is repeatedly steamed and rolled with flour until it becomes soft and fluffy. When it’s ready to finally serve, it can be combined with almost anything as a complementary dish.

When consumed, it grants a +2 enhancement bonus to AC, or increases an existing enhancement bonus by +2, to a maximum of +5. If the bonus would exceed +5, it grants either or both the deathless or stanching armor special abilities. A 20th-level or lower creature can’t gain more than a full +10 value of enhancements or special abilities in this way.

Additional ingredients increase the enhancement bonus and serving size by +1 each, to a maximum of a +5 enhancement, and adds ghost touch and wild to the abilities the creature can choose.
